st: Bricker's Boy/ Lotions Of Love/ The Hustlers

st: The Misunderstanding/ Love Below Decks/ The End Is Near

st: Julie's Blind Date/ Dee Dee's Dilemma/ The Prizewinner

st: Love On Strike/ Looking For Mr. Wilson/ The Last Case

st: Hong Kong Cruise: Polly'S Poker Palace - Part 2

st: When World's Collide/ Captain And The Geisha/ The Lottery Winners/ The Emperor's Fortune - Part 2

st: Best Ex-Friends/ All The Congressman's Women/ Three Faces Of Love

st: Ace In The Hole/ Uncle Joey's Song/ Father In The Cradle
